cost: Parse O(B); tree repeated leaves/scans O(n*d+n²) or larger repeated subtree work on pathological nesting; check O(n²), sort O(n log n), conllu O(n²+output bytes). Depth/allocation bounded in fixtures, batch buffers retained. No speed claim.
description: XML event reader builds words/groups. tree splices function groups, chooses ordered heads, attaches relations and postprocesses lemor/relative/fixed/article rules. check validates roots and walks heads. surface_order transports arcs under stable id sort. conllu expands words/punctuation/MWT and transports heads again. Main splits strict Aramaic majority then writes books/maps; lessons/compare unexecuted.

CoNLL-U admits different source groupings/order/metadata. Arcs invert only with permutation; original top cannot be recovered after reorder. Majority admits all assignments satisfying counts. Output cannot reconstruct omitted/bad sentences.
limitations: Synthetic XML/tree/helpers only; all relation combinations, malformed XML, effects and teacher workflows untested.
